title: SDK-sent $experiment_exposure properties
description: Closed projection of the properties of an SDK-sent exposure. The SDK sends it only for a config version 2 experiment split, so it carries no config version, rule type, reason code or source marker; the rule ID marks it as SDK-sent. Experiment ID and forced-variant context are forbidden. Capture identity and existing optional transport properties are outside this projection. Scan the entire event recursively for assignment seeds.
